name: tab-history-long-open-tabs
description: Find tabs you kept open for days and then closed: a list of long-open tabs, most recently closed first.

scripts.lint: node --check src/defaults.js && node --check src/tabs-logic.js && node --check src/background.js && node --check src/sidebar.js && node --check src/theme.js && node --check src/i18n.js && for f in src/locales/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done && for f in targets/*/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done && node --check build.cjs && node --check test/run.cjs
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:opera
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && rm -f browser-tabs-firefox.zip && cd dist/firefox && zip -qrX -FS ../../browser-tabs-firefox.zip . -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && rm -f browser-tabs-chrome.zip && cd dist/chrome && zip -qrX -FS ../../browser-tabs-chrome.zip . -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.package:opera: npm run build:opera && rm -f browser-tabs-opera.zip && cd dist/opera && zip -qrX -FS ../../browser-tabs-opera.zip . -x '*.DS_Store'

author: Tim Pyrkov
